items.text: ___ a customer pays by credit card, our system automatically sends a receipt to the registered address.

ok.de: Feste Regel, die immer gilt: if/when + Gegenwart, Gegenwart.
ok.en: A fixed rule that always applies: if/when + present, present.

wrong.de: although heißt „obwohl“ und passt nicht zu einer festen Regel.
wrong.en: although means “even though” and does not fit a fixed rule.

wrong.de: unless heißt „außer wenn“; hier gilt die Regel gerade, wenn gezahlt wird.
wrong.en: unless means “except if”; here the rule applies exactly when someone pays.

wrong.de: despite braucht ein Nomen oder -ing, keinen ganzen Satz.
wrong.en: despite needs a noun or -ing, not a full clause.

items.text: If the sun ___ out all day, the plants on my balcony grow much faster than in cloudy weeks.

ok.de: Zero Conditional: if + Gegenwart, Gegenwart; hier is out (oder stays out).
ok.en: Zero conditional: if + present, present; here is out (or stays out).

wrong.de: will steht nicht im if-Satz; nach if bleibt die Gegenwart.
wrong.en: will does not belong in the if-clause; after if the present stays.

wrong.de: was ist Vergangenheit, die Regel gilt aber immer (grow).
wrong.en: was is past, but the rule always applies (grow).

wrong.de: would steht nicht im if-Satz.
wrong.en: would does not belong in the if-clause.

items.text: If you do not hurry with the proposal, you ___ miss the deadline, and the client will go to a competitor.

ok.de: Reale Möglichkeit: if + Gegenwart, will (oder may/might) + Grundform.
ok.en: A real possibility: if + present, will (or may/might) + base form.

wrong.de: would passt zu einer unwahrscheinlichen Annahme, hier ist die Folge real möglich.
wrong.en: would fits an unlikely assumption, but here the result is really possible.

wrong.de: did miss gibt es hier nicht; es geht um die Zukunft.
wrong.en: did miss does not fit here; this is about the future.

wrong.de: were miss gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: were miss does not exist.

items.text: If I ___ you, I would sleep on it before signing such a long-term contract.

ok.de: Rat und Annahme: If I were you, … (were auch bei I).
ok.en: Advice and assumption: If I were you, … (were even with I).

wrong.de: Nach if I steht in dieser Rede were; „if I am you“ passt nicht zu einem Ratschlag.
wrong.en: After if I this advice form takes were; “if I am you” does not fit advice.

wrong.de: if I be you gibt es im modernen Englisch nicht.
wrong.en: if I be you does not exist in modern English.

wrong.de: would steht im Hauptsatz, nicht im if-Satz.
wrong.en: would belongs in the main clause, not the if-clause.

items.text: Could you tell me ___ is responsible for the archive migration, because I need to send them the contract?

ok.de: Indirekte Frage nach einer Person als Subjekt: tell me who is responsible (kein do, keine Umstellung).
ok.en: An indirect question about a person as subject: tell me who is responsible (no do, no inversion).

wrong.de: whom wäre Objektform; hier ist die Lücke das Subjekt von is responsible.
wrong.en: whom is the object form; here the gap is the subject of is responsible.

wrong.de: whose zeigt Besitz („wessen“), hier wird nach der Person gefragt.
wrong.en: whose shows possession, but here the person is asked for.

wrong.de: what fragt nach Sachen, nicht nach einer verantwortlichen Person.
wrong.en: what asks about things, not about a responsible person.

items.text: If our company ___ more money to spend, we would hire another developer for the cloud team immediately.

ok.de: Unwirkliche Gegenwart: if + Past Simple, would + Grundform.
ok.en: Unreal present: if + past simple, would + base form.

wrong.de: has passt nicht zu if + Vergangenheitsform; hier geht es um eine unwirkliche Annahme.
wrong.en: has does not fit if + past form; this is an unreal assumption.

wrong.de: have ist Gegenwart; für die unwirkliche Annahme braucht der if-Satz die Vergangenheit.
wrong.en: have is present; the unreal if-clause needs the past.

wrong.de: would steht im Hauptsatz, nicht nach if.
wrong.en: would belongs in the main clause, not after if.

items.text: If I won the lottery next week, I ___ quit my job and travel around the world for a year.

ok.de: Unwirkliche Annahme: if + Past Simple, would + Grundform.
ok.en: An unreal assumption: if + past simple, would + base form.

wrong.de: will passt zu realen Annahmen; „won“ zeigt hier eine unwirkliche.
wrong.en: will fits real conditions; “won” shows an unreal one here.

wrong.de: did quit gibt es hier nicht; es geht um Wünsche in der Zukunft.
wrong.en: did quit does not fit; this is about wishes for the future.

wrong.de: had quit wäre Vergangenheit.
wrong.en: had quit would be past.

items.text: If the vendor had warned us earlier, we ___ have switched the provider before the outage.

ok.de: Verpasste Chance: if + Past Perfect, would have + Partizip.
ok.en: A missed chance: if + past perfect, would have + participle.

wrong.de: will have steht nicht in einer verpassten Vergangenheit.
wrong.en: will have does not belong to a missed past.

wrong.de: had have gibt es nicht; im Hauptsatz steht would have + Partizip.
wrong.en: had have does not exist; the main clause takes would have + participle.

wrong.de: did have drückt keine verpasste Möglichkeit aus.
wrong.en: did have does not express a missed possibility.

items.text: If the weather had been better, we would ___ finished the roof by the end of March.

ok.de: Hauptsatz der dritten Bedingung: would have + Partizip.
ok.en: The main clause of the third conditional: would have + participle.

wrong.de: would had gibt es nicht; nach would steht have.
wrong.en: would had does not exist; would is followed by have.

wrong.de: would be delivered wäre Passiv und passt nicht zum Sinn.
wrong.en: would be delivered would be passive and does not fit the meaning.

wrong.de: would has gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: would has does not exist.

items.text: You may use the company car this weekend ___ that you promise to bring it back with a full tank by Monday.

ok.de: Bedingung mit Auflage: provided/providing (that) + Gegenwart.
ok.en: A condition with a requirement: provided/providing (that) + present.

wrong.de: unless würde die Bedingung umkehren: nur wenn du es nicht versprichst.
wrong.en: unless would reverse the condition: only if you do not promise it.

wrong.de: although heißt „obwohl“ und nennt keine Bedingung.
wrong.en: although means “even though” and names no condition.

wrong.de: until nennt einen Zeitpunkt, keine Bedingung.
wrong.en: until names a point in time, not a condition.

items.text: We will not start the implementation ___ the client has paid the first invoice in full.

ok.de: Voraussetzung: not … unless/until + Gegenwart, ohne extra not im Nebensatz.
ok.en: A requirement: not … unless/until + present, with no extra not in the clause.

wrong.de: if würde die Bedeutung umkehren: Wir starten nicht, falls bezahlt wurde.
wrong.en: if would reverse the meaning: we do not start if it has been paid.

wrong.de: although heißt „obwohl“ und passt nicht zu einer Voraussetzung.
wrong.en: although means “even though” and does not fit a requirement.

wrong.de: since heißt „seit“ oder „weil“ und passt nicht zu einer Voraussetzung.
wrong.en: since means “from the time” or “because” and does not fit a requirement.

items.text: We will cancel the order ___ the supplier confirms the delivery date by Monday at the latest.

ok.de: unless = if … not: außer, der Lieferant bestätigt. Im Nebensatz steht kein zweites not.
ok.en: unless = if … not: except if the supplier confirms. No second not in the clause.

wrong.de: if würde die Bedeutung umkehren: Wir stornieren, falls er bestätigt.
wrong.en: if would reverse the meaning: we cancel if he confirms.

wrong.de: until nennt einen Endpunkt, keine Ausnahme.
wrong.en: until names an end point, not an exception.

wrong.de: although heißt „obwohl“ und passt nicht zu einer Ausnahme.
wrong.en: although means “even though” and does not fit an exception.

items.text: Please do not call me before noon ___ it is really urgent, because I am working night shifts this week.

ok.de: Ausnahme: do not call … unless it is urgent.
ok.en: An exception: do not call … unless it is urgent.

wrong.de: if würde die Bitte umkehren: „ruf nicht an, wenn es dringend ist“.
wrong.en: if would reverse the request: “do not call if it is urgent”.

wrong.de: until nennt einen Endpunkt, hier fehlt die Ausnahme.
wrong.en: until names an end point, but the exception is missing.

wrong.de: because gibt einen Grund an, keine Ausnahme.
wrong.en: because gives a reason, not an exception.

items.text: You can use my laptop for the demo ___ long as you save all the files on the shared company drive.

ok.de: Nur unter einer Bedingung: as long as (oder so long as) + Gegenwart.
ok.en: Only under one condition: as long as (or so long as) + present.

wrong.de: too long as ist keine Wendung.
wrong.en: too long as is not a phrase.

wrong.de: very long as ist keine Wendung.
wrong.en: very long as is not a phrase.

wrong.de: how long as ist keine Wendung.
wrong.en: how long as is not a phrase.

items.text: You can stay in our guest room as long ___ you need; we are not using it before June.

ok.de: as long as = solange: die Bedingung gilt, bis sie endet.
ok.en: as long as = for as long as: the condition holds until it ends.

wrong.de: as long than ist falsch; die Wendung ist as long as.
wrong.en: as long than is wrong; the phrase is as long as.

wrong.de: as long so gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: as long so does not exist.

wrong.de: as long like gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: as long like does not exist.

items.text: Please send the signed copy by this afternoon. ___, we cannot start the project on Monday as planned.

ok.de: Otherwise = sonst: sagt, was passiert, wenn die Bitte nicht erfüllt wird.
ok.en: Otherwise = or else: it says what happens if the request is not met.

wrong.de: therefore nennt eine Folge, hier folgt aber eine Warnung („sonst“).
wrong.en: therefore names a result, but here a warning (“or else”) follows.

wrong.de: moreover fügt etwas Gleichartiges hinzu, keine Warnung.
wrong.en: moreover adds something similar, not a warning.

wrong.de: instead heißt „stattdessen“.
wrong.en: instead means “in place of that”.

items.text: You should back up your files every week; ___, you may lose important data when the laptop fails.

ok.de: Otherwise = sonst: die Folge, falls man es nicht tut.
ok.en: Otherwise = or else: the consequence if you do not do it.

wrong.de: therefore nennt eine Folge, keine Warnung.
wrong.en: therefore names a result, not a warning.

wrong.de: moreover fügt nur etwas hinzu.
wrong.en: moreover only adds something.

wrong.de: furthermore fügt nur etwas hinzu.
wrong.en: furthermore only adds something.

items.text: ___ for the quick help of our neighbors, the whole cellar would have been flooded last night.

ok.de: But for + Nomen = ohne (eine verpasste Hilfe): But for X, … would have …
ok.en: But for + noun = without (a help that was there): But for X, … would have …

wrong.de: Only for gibt es hier nicht; die Wendung heißt But for.
wrong.en: Only for does not fit here; the phrase is But for.

wrong.de: Not for ergibt eine andere Bedeutung.
wrong.en: Not for gives a different meaning.

wrong.de: Just for bedeutet „nur für“.
wrong.en: Just for means “only for”.

items.text: If it ___ not been for your advice, I would have accepted the first offer without any negotiation.

ok.de: If it had not been for … = hätte es … nicht gegeben (dritte Bedingung).
ok.en: If it had not been for … = had it not been for … (third conditional).

wrong.de: was been ist keine Form; es braucht had been.
wrong.en: was been is not a form; it needs had been.

wrong.de: were been ist keine Form.
wrong.en: were been is not a form.

wrong.de: has not been passt zur Gegenwart, hier geht es um die Vergangenheit.
wrong.en: has not been is present, but this is about the past.

items.text: ___ we known about the supplier's financial problems earlier, we would have changed the order immediately.

ok.de: Förmlich ohne if: Had + Subjekt + Partizip, would have … (= If we had known).
ok.en: Formal without if: Had + subject + participle, would have … (= If we had known).

wrong.de: Have we known gibt es hier nicht; die Umstellung der dritten Bedingung steht mit Had.
wrong.en: Have we known does not fit; the inverted third conditional starts with Had.

wrong.de: Did we known ist falsch; nach did steht die Grundform.
wrong.en: Did we known is wrong; after did comes the base form.

wrong.de: Would we known gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: Would we known does not exist.

items.text: ___ the client decide to cancel the contract, we will need to find a new buyer for the machines quickly.

ok.de: Förmlich für „falls“: Should + Subjekt + Grundform, … (= If the client decides).
ok.en: Formal for “if”: Should + subject + base form, … (= If the client decides).

wrong.de: Would the client decide ist keine Bedingungsform für etwas Mögliches.
wrong.en: Would the client decide is not a conditional form for a real possibility.

wrong.de: Could the client decide ist eine Frage nach Möglichkeit, keine Bedingung.
wrong.en: Could the client decide is a question of possibility, not a condition.

wrong.de: Will the client decide wäre eine Frage.
wrong.en: Will the client decide would be a question.

items.text: Were we ___ extend the offer by another month, the price would have to go up by about five percent.

ok.de: Förmlich für eine unwahrscheinliche Annahme: Were + Subjekt + to + Grundform, … would …
ok.en: Formal for an unlikely assumption: Were + subject + to + base form, … would …

wrong.de: Were we not extend ist falsch; es heißt Were we to + Grundform.
wrong.en: Were we not extend is wrong; it is Were we to + base form.

wrong.de: Were we for extend gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: Were we for extend does not exist.

wrong.de: Were we going extend ist falsch; going bräuchte to.
wrong.en: Were we going extend is wrong; going would need to.

items.text: Pack a warm jacket ___ case the evening gets cold, because the mountain weather can change quickly.

ok.de: Vorsorge: in case + Gegenwart (nicht if), wegen etwas, das passieren könnte.
ok.en: Precaution: in case + present (not if), because of something that might happen.

wrong.de: on case gibt es nicht; die feste Wendung heißt in case.
wrong.en: on case does not exist; the fixed phrase is in case.

wrong.de: at case gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: at case does not exist.

wrong.de: by case gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: by case does not exist.

items.text: Let me give you my cell phone number just ___ case you cannot reach me at the office during the trade fair.

ok.de: Just in case = für alle Fälle, mit Gegenwart im Nebensatz.
ok.en: Just in case = to be on the safe side, with the present in the clause.

wrong.de: just on case gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: just on case does not exist.

wrong.de: just at case gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: just at case does not exist.

wrong.de: just for case gibt es nicht; es heißt just in case.
wrong.en: just for case does not exist; it is just in case.

items.text: I would be grateful if you ___ send me the revised draft by Friday, so that I can forward it to the board.

ok.de: Höfliche Bitte: I would be grateful if you could/would + Grundform.
ok.en: A polite request: I would be grateful if you could/would + base form.

wrong.de: if you did send ist betont und passt nicht zu einer höflichen Bitte.
wrong.en: if you did send is emphatic and does not fit a polite request.

wrong.de: if you were send gibt es nicht.
wrong.en: if you were send does not exist.

wrong.de: if you had send gibt es nicht; had braucht ein Partizip (sent).
wrong.en: if you had send does not exist; had needs a participle (sent).

items.text: I will join you for dinner tonight ___ my flight from Hamburg is delayed by more than an hour.

ok.de: unless = außer wenn: nur eine Ausnahme verhindert es.
ok.en: unless = except if: only one exception would stop it.

wrong.de: if würde die Bedeutung umkehren: Ich komme nur, falls der Flug verspätet ist.
wrong.en: if would reverse the meaning: I only come if the flight is delayed.

wrong.de: until nennt einen Endpunkt und passt hier nicht.
wrong.en: until names an end point and does not fit here.

wrong.de: although heißt „obwohl“ und nennt keine Ausnahme.
wrong.en: although means “even though” and names no exception.

items.text: The street festival will take place on Saturday ___ the forecast shows heavy rain on Friday night.

ok.de: Eine Ausnahme verhindert den Plan: unless + Gegenwart.
ok.en: One exception would stop the plan: unless + present.

wrong.de: if würde die Bedeutung umkehren: Start, falls Probleme auftauchen.
wrong.en: if would reverse the meaning: go live if problems appear.

wrong.de: although passt nicht zu einer möglichen Ausnahme.
wrong.en: although does not fit a possible exception.

wrong.de: when meint einen sicheren Zeitpunkt, hier geht es um eine Ausnahme.
wrong.en: when means a certain moment, but this is an exception.
